title: Sallow
summary: SAL'LOW, noun [Latin salix.] A tree of the willow kind, or genus Salix. SAL'LOW, adjective [Latin salix, the tree, supra.] Having a yellowish color; of a pale sickly color, tinged with a dark yellow;

inlines.v: SAL'LOW, noun [Latin salix.] A tree of the willow kind, or genus Salix. SAL'LOW, adjective [Latin salix, the tree, supra.] Having a yellowish color; of a pale sickly color, tinged with a dark yellow; as a sallow skin.
